title: Lissajous Web
subtitle: 3D Projected Harmonic Knot Curves
description: Three-dimensional Bowditch-Lissajous knot curves projected into 2D space with rotating perspective depth attenuation.
mathNotation: x(t) = \sin(a t + \delta), \quad y(t) = \sin(b t), \quad z(t) = \cos(c t)
formulaCompact: x = sin(3φ + δ),  y = sin(4φ),  z = cos(5φ + t),  px = cx + rotX * depth
